title: Project Aegis seed-grid experiment definition
description: DRG-257 / INF-6.1 seed-only stub. One scenario crossed with the ordered seeds array; duplicate seeds request repeated runs. Doctrine and ROE identifiers are opaque metadata only, never runtime overrides. Force-ratio and multi-parameter sweeps are deferred.

scenarioId.description: An existing scenario policy identifier. Unknown identifiers fail at execution.

seeds.description: The seed grid in execution order. Never sorted or deduplicated; integer tokens only.

ticks.description: Positive tick count per run; integer token only.

doctrineId.description: Optional opaque metadata label. Has no effect on runtime doctrine or fingerprints. Omit when absent.

roeId.description: Optional opaque metadata label. Has no effect on runtime ROE or fingerprints. Omit when absent.
